title: Synthetic Data FeatureCloud App
summary: A FeatureCloud platform app that generates synthetic tabular datasets from an uploaded dataset, letting the user pick GaussianCopula, CTGAN, TVAE, or CopulaGAN and anonymize selected fields. The app's states.py imports SDV's tabular synthesizers (sdv.tabular.copulagan.CopulaGAN, sdv.tabular.copulas.GaussianCopula, sdv.tabular.ctgan.CTGAN/TVAE) and SDV's Metadata class to actually perform the synthetic data generation.
evidence: states.py: 'from sdv.tabular.copulagan import CopulaGAN' / 'from sdv.tabular.ctgan import CTGAN, TVAE'; requirements.txt: sdv==0.18
